title: Re-count the published person figures and commit the query as a receipt
evidence: The value 339217 appears in NO file on ANY branch of sisodias/siso-people-graph. Amended in the Great Library at commit fad12f1, registry/works/siso-people-graph.json, verified flag set false.

spec.description: Published counts (person=339,217, person_person=1,272,495, organisation=1,131) survive only as a prose summary. No query log, receipt or reproducible artifact backs them.
spec.context: Neither independent audit could re-count them. Red team: 'No production SQLite assets were opened. Dataset-wide counts and collision rates are therefore not claimed.' First-principles audit: 'Published row counts are therefore treated as repository claims, not independently re-counted observations', because its connector 'did not expose arbitrary SQL execution against the published 688 MB graph release asset'. Separately PGRT-002/003/009/016 establish person rows are not defensible as DISTINCT-HUMAN counts under name fusion, 0.98 attribute auto-accept and CJK label collapse to a comma. Row count and distinct-human count are different claims and must be reported separately. RESOLVED by the GQ-010 baseline: 339,217 IS correct, verified directly against the shipped asset (db SHA-256 9938237a33277fe3...). It greps to nothing because it is stated in the graph-v2 RELEASE TITLE, not a tracked file. The Great Library record has been restored to verified:true. WHAT REMAINS: the 1,272,495 person_person rows are crates.io PACKAGE DEPENDENCIES at flat 0.95 confidence, not human relations (§3.3) - that half of the claim still needs correcting wherever it is cited.
acceptance_criteria: The counting query is committed as a re-runnable receipt
Row counts and the distinct-human question are reported separately
The Great Library Work record moves from repository-asserted to verified ONLY if the re-count succeeds
